description: This file defines a FastAPI application with dependency injection that leverages query parameters and cookies to extract values and use them within an endpoint.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query parameter 'q' which can be a string or None.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: Annotated[str, Depends(query_extractor)], last_query: Annotated[Union[str, None], Cookie()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves 'q' from query parameters or cookie 'last_query' if 'q' is not provided.

methods.name: read_query( query_or_default: Annotated[str, Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor)], )
methods.description: FastAPI route handler that uses dependency injection to get a query or cookie value and returns it.
